reasoning_checks: Derived return identities from dated wealth and actual share holdings; reinvested versus retained distributions are separate strategies.

Log identities require positive growth; total loss has no finite log and negative financed equity is outside the log domain. Jensen statements identify nonnegative weights, equality and finite-expectation conditions.
Expected future wealth factors only with explicit independence; a realized geometric return is not a one-period expected-return estimate.
True TWR splits at known external-flow valuations. Two different intermediate valuations yield different TWRs for the same investor-flow IRR; no endpoint-only identification claim.
IRR uniqueness is proved only for the nonnegative contribution/positive liquidation fixture. Exercise4 analytically identifies both roots for the separate binding-capital-call stream.
Fees specify bases and dates; currency quote orientation, price-level division and fictional tax bases are explicit. No numerical current tax or regulatory-compliance claim.
Portfolio return follows complete beginning-wealth financing. Log asset aggregation, hindsight weights and statewise winner choice are explicitly distinguished from achievable wealth.
Every state inequality is intersected with long-only bounds. Exercise8 activates an additional lower bound when the loss floor tightens.
Every exercise solution was independently recalculated; all preceding methods taught. Alternative source/evidence critiques have explicit grading criteria.
